together.says: They see each change as it’s made, and make their own. Everyone keeps their own copy.
together.days: Changes wait 7 days for anyone away.
together.invited: Invitations sent. They have a week to join.
together.moves: When you remove someone or turn the link off, everyone already in moves with you; only people who haven’t joined yet need a new link. What a person already has stays theirs.
together.yourName: Your name, as the others will see it
together.newcomer: Nothing to install, no account. Everyone keeps their own copy, on their own device.
together.removed: You’re no longer in “{title}”. What you have stays yours.
together.stopped: Working together on “{title}” stopped. Your copy stays yours.
together.noPlace: Working on something together isn’t available here.
together.inside: Your organisation adds people from its list. Ask to be invited by name.
together.gone: This link no longer opens anything. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
